channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Chennai’s Padmanaban Gopalan: 2014 Food Rescue from Wedding Waste Now Feeds 40,000 Monthly
item.description: Padmanaban Gopalan's No Food Waste turns Chennai's lavish wedding leftovers into 40,000 monthly meals for the needy since 2014.

item.title: Kerala Actress Assault Case: Six Convicts Sentenced to 20 Years Rigorous Imprisonment for Gang Rape
item.description: Six convicts in the 2017 Kerala actor assault case were sentenced to 20 years rigorous imprisonment for gang rape.

item.title: PM Modi Launches ‘Your Money, Your Right’ Campaign to Help Indians Reclaim ₹1 Lakh Crore in Forgotten Assets
item.description: A government-led campaign combining digital portals and district-level camps is helping Indians recover long-forgotten bank deposits, insurance claims, mutual funds and dividends.

item.title: Olympian Antim Panghal Clinches Gold in Women’s 55kg Senior National Wrestling Championship 2025
item.description: Wrestler Antim Panghal secured a gold medal in the women's 55kg category at the Senior National Championship.

item.title: UP Horror: Class 10 Boy Arrested for Allegedly Raping, Blackmailing Junior, Forces Her to Steal Mother’s ₹1.5 Lakh Gold Jewellery
item.description: Police say the accused used objectionable photos to blackmail a Class 8 girl into stealing gold jewellery from her own home.

item.title: “Baraat ki Jagah Arthi Nikli”: Tracing the Strain, Fear and Uncertainty Surrounding Booth Level Officers in SIR Drive
item.description: SIR Drive: A voter-roll audit meant to protect democracy is instead leaving poll workers overwhelmed, fearful, and fighting for dignity.

item.title: Delhi AQI Exceeds 400, Air Quality Slips Into ‘Severe’ Zone; GRAP-III Curbs Reimposed Across NCR
item.description: Delhi’s air quality plunged into the ‘severe’ category due to rising pollution levels, forcing authorities to reimpose GRAP-III emergency restrictions across the NCR to protect public health.

item.title: Running Past 60: How Milind Soman’s Grandmother’s 10K Initiative Is Transforming Senior Women’s Health and Public Perception
item.description: India’s Grandmother's 10K challenges age stereotypes, celebrates active ageing, and shows how senior women are reclaiming health, confidence, and public spaces—one step at a time.

item.title: Messi’s Kolkata Stadium Visit Turns Chaotic as Fans Clash with Officials over Limited Access
item.description: Thousands of fans who paid premium prices were left angry after poor planning, VIP crowding and Messi’s short stadium appearance triggered unrest in Kolkata.

item.title: Union Cabinet Approves ₹11,718 Crore for India’s First Digital 2027 Census with Caste Enumeration, No NPR
item.description: The Union Cabinet has greenlit ₹11,718.24 crore for a fully digital Census 2027, featuring India's first post-independence caste count and advanced tech, sans separate NPR funding.
